step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture visualizes automated sensitive data discovery and reporting across AWS accounts. Amazon Macie analyzes S3 buckets and exports finding metadata into a central S3 bucket. Amazon Athena queries this finding metadata in S3, while Amazon QuickSight connects to retrieve visualization data. Data is also exported from S3 into a MySQL database. AWS Glue provides background data processing, and Security Engineers access QuickSight dashboards.
